cells.note: Reassessed 2026-11-09: the minister said in May 2025 that Congo is linked by fibre to five neighbours beside the 2Africa landing at Pointe-Noire, so a cable and a land route share no landing station (COG-010); 2Africa was activated in February 2024 (COG-003).
